answer: Sybil resistance should price collusion, not identity papers. Network caps new identities at 1 percent of established count per epoch, no exceptions. A forge of forged keys looks dense until audits weigh each edge; the walnut of penalties arrives on schedule, 10 percent of sampled edges re-verified per epoch, and knoll-light aliases never accrete the history that makes trust cheap. Stake forfeited is the only argument fakes understand.
